name: List
statusNote: @fluentui/react-list is a preview package at the kit's commit; the styles are minimal and most of the behaviour lives in its hooks.
summary: A vertical list of items that can be navigated with arrow keys and, optionally, selected one or many at a time, each item carrying a checkbox when selectable. Use it for rows of like content; a Tree nests, a Menu is for actions, a Table for columns.

inputs.name: navigationMode
inputs.description: items moves focus between the items with arrow keys; composite lets arrow keys move through focusable content inside each item as well.

inputs.name: selectionMode
inputs.description: Makes the items selectable, one or many; each item then shows a checkbox.

inputs.name: selectedItems
inputs.description: The selected item values, controlled; defaultSelectedItems seeds the uncontrolled form.

inputs.name: onSelectionChange
inputs.description: Runs with the new selected values when selection changes.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: A ListItem's value, what selection reports.

inputs.name: onAction
inputs.description: A ListItem's action, run on click or Enter when the item is navigable.

inputs.name: disabledSelection
inputs.description: Keeps one item out of selection while the list stays selectable.

anatomy.name: List
anatomy.description: A ul (or ol or div) with its padding, margin, indent and markers removed.

anatomy.name: ListItem
anatomy.description: An li (or div) with markers removed; a flex row with a pointer cursor when selectable or navigable.

anatomy.name: Checkmark
anatomy.description: The selection checkbox at the item's start, vertically centred, its indicator given a 4px margin.

variants.description: Items are plain rows; navigable ones are clickable.
One item at a time; each item renders a checkbox that reflects its state.
Any number of items; each item renders a checkbox.

layout.text: The list resets padding and margin to 0, text-indent to 0 and list-style-type to none.
An item resets the same, and when selectable or navigable is a flex row with a pointer cursor; a disabled item keeps the default cursor.
The checkbox slot aligns itself to the centre of the row and gives the checkbox's indicator a 4px margin on every side.

states.text: Rest: an item paints nothing of its own; its content carries the look.
Keyboard focus draws the default outline on the item: strokeWidthThick solid colorStrokeFocus2 with borderRadiusMedium, on the focus selector.
Selection shows only through the item's checkbox; the row itself has no selected colour in the styles file.
A disabled item shows the default cursor and takes no selection; nothing else changes visually.

behaviour.text: Arrow keys move focus between items (navigationMode items), or through the focusable content of each item too (composite); Home and End jump to the first and last item.
A click, Space or Enter on a selectable item toggles it (multiselect) or makes it the one selection (single); the checkbox reflects the value and onSelectionChange reports the set.
A navigable item runs onAction on click or Enter, with its value.

keyboard: Arrow Up and Down move between items
Home and End jump to the ends
Space or Enter selects or acts
semantics: a selectable list is a listbox whose items are options with aria-selected
a navigable list's items take the role the hooks assign (listItemRole)
an item's checkbox is the selection control assistive technology reads

notes.text: The 4px checkbox indicator margin is a constant; the row has no height, padding or hover colour of its own, so a list's density is the caller's content.
Row heights, hover and selected backgrounds are not in the package; the design site's list rows read as 32 or 44px with Subtle hover, which a caller adds to its item content.
